answers.1_exact_bug: Kvap_func receives soil temperature in degrees Celsius, but the saturated vapor-density expression used that Celsius value directly in a thermodynamic expression whose temperature is absolute Kelvin. MgRT and Da already converted to Kelvin, so the routine mixed temperature scales internally.
answers.2_source_authority: The defect is present in canonical SWAP4.3.1 B0 WC_K_models_04_11.f90 and survives the admitted B1 chain through B1.11. SWAP-009 changes signed-head calling semantics, SWAP-010 changes model-7 capacity algebra, and SWAP-011 adds derivative/cache logic but leaves the production Kvap_func Celsius use unresolved.
answers.3_physical_dimensional_correctness: The unique authority-consistent repair defines TK=Temp+273.15d0 and uses TK in MgRT, Da and Rho_sv. This makes the saturated-vapor-density equation use absolute temperature consistently while preserving the Celsius interface and SWAP-009 signed h in the Kelvin relative-humidity factor.
answers.4_results_that_change: Only PDI conductivity evaluations with vapor enabled are intended to change. The full-model Vapor-on control and repaired candidate differ in the qualified heat-bound case. The repaired candidate remains finite in the pathological dry case where the buggy zero-temperature-hosted control becomes non-finite.
answers.5_results_unchanged: NoVap control and candidate are numerically identical in the full-model gates. PDI retention, capacity, capillary conductivity and film conductivity are not changed by the patch. SWAP-009 signed-head semantics are preserved.
answers.6_production_admission: The correction is scientifically qualified for admission, but production admission is not yet provenance-complete because the exact repaired B1.11 target postimage SHA256 and repaired full source-manifest SHA256 cannot be derived from GitHub-only evidence without the exact canonical B1.11 source bytes.
answers.7_AHL_requalification: Do not reopen F-AHL. After the temperature fix is actually admitted upstream, run only F-AHL-PDI-VAPOR-REQUAL over the previously excluded/blocked PDI Vapor-on envelope using the corrected authoritative hydraulics. Retain existing NoVap and non-PDI AHL evidence unless the admitted source delta touches those paths.
